## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-09-13: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.2 to S-1/A
- 2021-09-28: TRA executed (preamble dated September 28, 2021) at IPO close; pre-IPO sponsors Welsh Carson, Warburg Pincus, and Permira as TRA Parties

#### Termination via Amendment No. 1

- 2024-11-04: Amendment No. 1 to the TRA executed; operative provision substitutes one-time Settlement Payments for all past, current, and future TRA obligations, conditioned on Unaffiliated Stockholder approval and absence of restraining order
- 2024-11-06: 8-K and Preliminary Proxy filed
- 2024-11-19: Definitive Proxy filed soliciting Unaffiliated Stockholder approval
- 2024-12-20: Unaffiliated Stockholder approval obtained at Special Meeting; Amendment No. 1 effective; TRA terminated; Settlement Payments begin

#### Wind-down

- Q1 2025: Final Settlement Payment installment paid; FY2025 10-K shows zero TRA liability

## Explanation

This Up-C TRA originated at the September 2021 IPO between Clearwater Analytics Holdings as Corporate Taxpayer and Welsh Carson, Warburg Pincus, and Permira affiliates as TRA Parties, paying 85% of Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit on Pre-Merger NOLs, Blocker Transferred Basis, Section 754 step-ups on later exchanges, TRA Bonus Deductions, and imputed interest. Three years later the parties negotiated a terminating amendment: Amendment No. 1 substitutes a one-time $72.5 million aggregate Settlement Payment (about $69.2M to TRA Parties and $3.3M in TRA Bonus Payments to executives) for all future obligations under the contract. The amendment was conditioned on Unaffiliated Stockholder approval, which was obtained December 20, 2024; settlement payments were made in December 2024 and Q1 2025, after which the TRA liability went to zero. A subsequent acquisition of Enfusion, Inc. and a pending Permira-led going-private merger announced December 2025 are TRA-independent corporate events. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
